narrative_prose: The Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea threatened to tear the gantry apart. Hector tasted the sharp, coppery tang of ozone as the icy, howling winds bit through his suit. The turbulent, oily black waves crashed against the jagged iron-stone cliffs, a dizzying display of natural fury. He gripped the rails to DEFEND his footing against the storm's brutal push, squinting through the thick, localized sea mist designed to CONCEAL the worst of the hazards. Shouting over the chaotic roar, Hector waved his arm to ATTRACT Kaio's attention. He lunged forward and slammed the heavy physical baton into Kaio's grip, successfully handing it off.
